document.h: Curriculum Vitae - Franck Delahaye - Microservices Engineer (Canonical)

section.p: Headline: Senior software engineer & solutions architect - API integration, microservices, CI/CD, Linux, high-traffic platforms.

Senior software engineer and solutions architect with 25+ years of experience building and evolving backend services, REST APIs, and integration platforms for high-traffic Internet systems. Strong focus on API design and documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger), microservice-oriented refactoring of legacy platforms, relational and non-relational data stores (MySQL, PostgreSQL, XML DB), and pragmatic DevOps practices (CI/CD, Docker, AWS, Ubuntu). Experienced technical lead in distributed collaboration contexts: architecture reviews, incident debugging, test strategy, and mentoring engineers.

li.p: Backend & APIs: REST API design, OpenAPI/Swagger, API governance basics, Webhooks, OAuth2 flows, integration patterns (request/response mapping, idempotency considerations, async orchestration).

Microservices & distributed systems: service-oriented refactoring of legacy platforms, workflow orchestration, message-oriented designs, resilience-minded delivery (retries, timeouts, observability-driven debugging).
Languages & frameworks: Python (ERP integrations and automation), PHP/Symfony (service backends and APIs), Ballerina (API orchestration tooling), Java/J2EE (large-scale platforms).
Datastores: MySQL, PostgreSQL, XML databases (BaseX, eXist-db), search backends (Lucene, Vespa, Algolia) with performance tuning experience.
DevOps & operations: CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD), Docker-based environments, AWS VM/container deployments, Linux/Ubuntu, production monitoring with logs and dashboards (Kibana).
Engineering quality: automated testing (end-to-end browser tests), regression prevention, code reviews, mentoring, estimation and delivery planning with stakeholders.

p.strong: Cosmobilis (Chambery, France) - Senior Lead Developer & Architect - Internet platforms and integration services

li.p: Jan 2023 - Present

p.strong: API integration & microservices on high-traffic, multi-country marketplaces

li.p: Designed, implemented, and evolved REST APIs and partner integrations across critical domains: vehicle offers, financing, master data, trade-in valuation, CRM (Salesforce), search (Algolia), marketplaces, mailing, and legal workflows (registration, eco tax).

Led architecture evolution toward service-oriented and workflow-based orchestration: OpenAPI-driven contracts, mapping between systems, multi-country flows, and reliability improvements through scenario testing and regression detection.
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows (GitHub), coordinated Docker/AWS infrastructure setup with DevOps, and contributed to operational stability on Ubuntu-based environments.
Technical leadership: managed and mentored developers (up to 8), ran architecture discussions and reviews, produced estimates, and drove iterative delivery with distributed stakeholders.

p.strong: Enterprise Application Integration Service (Salesforce to dealership ERP workflows)

li.p: Developed an API-based integration service between Salesforce and OpenFlex dealership ERP: opportunity creation, status synchronization, mapping rules, and multi-country handling.
Introduced observable, message-oriented orchestration direction and automated end-to-end scenarios to reduce production incidents and improve turnaround time for fixes.

p.strong: Ballerina - API Orchestration & Microservices Tooling (internal productized PoCs)

li.p: Oct 2024 - Present
Developed a Ballerina-based workflow runner that executes typed JSON-defined API sequences ("SchemedTalks"), enabling repeatable orchestration and interactive execution via Swagger UI/OpenAPI.
Implemented secure REST integrations using OAuth2 request types, response re-use through JSONPath extraction, and memory-based variable injection for dynamic workflows.
Created componentized Ballerina service architecture (monorepo modules/connectors) and CI/CD for incremental migration toward reusable integration packages.

p.strong: Made In Design / Bilendi / Arturia (Grenoble, France) - Senior Solutions Architect & Developer

li.p: Designed and evolved service-oriented e-commerce and loyalty platforms with extensive third-party integrations (payments, marketplaces, marketing tooling, ERP/PIM/CRM), including Talend-based data pipelines and API-driven interoperability.

Implemented and maintained CI/CD pipelines (GitLab), Dockerized environments, and production monitoring practices; contributed to multiple major migrations (Symfony/PHP versions, platform refactoring, service separation).
Python work on Odoo ERP integrations and customizations (sales, purchases, warehouse, helpdesk, accounting), including data synchronization between systems backed by PostgreSQL.

p.strong: Kelkoo (later Yahoo) (Grenoble, France) - Senior Java Developer - Search APIs at scale

li.p: Maintained and evolved Lucene-based search APIs within a large component-based J2EE platform; performance-oriented improvements for high-traffic query workloads.
Contributed to migration toward a distributed REST/XML search backend (Yahoo Vespa) to improve scalability and result delivery.

p.strong: 1989-1991 - Polytech Grenoble - Engineering degree, IT & automation
1985-1988 - DEUG A - General science diploma - Universite Joseph Fourier, Grenoble

section.p: Nature and outdoor activities (trekking, snowboarding), discovering other cultures, and understanding how complex systems (technical, social, organizational) behave and evolve.

li.p: Linux/Ubuntu daily user; comfortable in globally distributed teams; available for twice-yearly travel for company events.
Open source mindset and long-term experience integrating heterogeneous systems via stable contracts and automation.
